prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing, identity-preserving photographic production asset.
Input image is the identity, wardrobe, camera angle and lighting reference for the elderly mother. Generate ONE 2 by 2 sprite rig atlas with FOUR NON-OVERLAPPING isolated photographic cutout assets, on a truly TRANSPARENT alpha background. Large square canvas, each asset entirely inside its own equal quadrant with generous transparent gutters. No text, labels, grid lines, drop shadows or drawn outlines. This is for hand-built articulated 2D animation of dish washing, not an assembled scene.
TOP LEFT quadrant: ONLY the exact same 73-year-old Western mother's silver curly hair, gentle looking-down face, neck, navy knitted cardigan shoulder-and-torso and terracotta apron to hips. No arms or hands at all: the torso has smooth rounded shoulder caps hidden under cardigan, intended to be overlapped by separately rigged upper arms. Preserve the reference face, realistic age, skin, ivory blouse and cardigan/apron fabric. Three-quarter view facing left, eyes looking down at the dish, warm window light from the left.
TOP RIGHT quadrant: her LEFT arm as one continuous photographic cutout, navy cardigan sleeve from upper arm through bent elbow to forearm, realistic wrinkled hand supporting a plain white ceramic dish tilted toward the camera. Upper arm on the right of this cutout, elbow bends down, forearm reaches to the left, dish on the left. Include a rounded full shoulder cap to overlap torso. Dish is clean and entirely visible; realistic five-finger anatomy, small amount of soapy water, no other objects.
BOTTOM LEFT quadrant: ONLY her RIGHT upper arm and navy cardigan knitted sleeve, a curved rounded isolated segment from shoulder to elbow, slanting down-left. Both ends rounded with a little overlap room for joint rigging. No hand, no torso.
BOTTOM RIGHT quadrant: ONLY her RIGHT forearm and hand firmly holding one small yellow sponge, skin matches this elderly mother, cardigan cuff at elbow end. Elbow end on the right, wrist then hand reaches down-left, the sponge below the fingers as if rubbing the surface of the separate white dish. All five fingers anatomically plausible, natural foam around sponge. Include the whole forearm from rounded elbow end with room to overlap sleeve. No plate in this quadrant.
All four assets share the same perspective, realistic soft warm side lighting, photographic grain, fabric texture and natural color grade of the reference. Each quadrant isolated, no duplicate arms, no duplicated faces, no extra objects. This must look like real photographed cutouts, never illustration, CGI or cartoon. No hearing aid or medical device. Preserve true alpha.
